Off-Market Acquisition Deal Origination in India

Off-market deal origination is the systematic discovery and qualification of potential acquisitions that are not necessarily being advertised for sale. It begins with a buyer’s specific thesis and consent-based conversations with owners.

Start a private enquiry ↗

Define a mandate that can be executed

Specify sector, geography, enterprise value or equity budget, earnings profile, stake preference, exclusions and strategic rationale. Identify the executive or investment committee responsible for approving the acquisition. Vague mandates tend to produce irrelevant introductions.

Build a target universe

Map businesses against the mandate through public information, industry expertise and trusted origination relationships. Distinguish verified operating facts from estimates. A target’s fit is not evidence that it is willing to sell.

Qualify owner interest before disclosure

Approach owners sensitively, understand their objectives and agree what information can be shared. Use appropriate confidentiality arrangements before exchanging identifying details or financial information. Avoid circulating speculative targets as confirmed opportunities.

How Legacy Search can help

Our public website describes a pan-India origination network and acquisition mandate value range of ₹100–2,000 crore. We work from a defined buyer brief to surface and qualify relevant conversations, with availability dependent on the mandate.

Common questions

Does off-market mean a discounted acquisition?

No. It describes how an opportunity is discovered, not its valuation or likelihood of closing.

Can you guarantee exclusive opportunities?

No. Exclusivity and availability depend on the specific owner, mandate and contractual arrangements.

General information only; not legal, tax or investment advice. Transaction availability, suitability and execution depend on the circumstances.
